review.reason: The course layout, mapped fairways and hazards, and walking connectors generally correspond to the numbered diagram. However, all three greens are rendered as inset light-green discs surrounded by broad, contrasting dark rings, rather than as single continuous natural putting surfaces.

issues.detail: G1 has a conspicuous multi-band dark ring around the putting surface; reduce it to a narrow natural fringe and ordinary edge shading.
G2 reads as a separate inset disc within a broad dark circular band, giving it a ringed-platform appearance; render one continuous putting surface.
G3 has a broad contrasting surround that makes the green look nested; make the edge transition narrower and more natural.
